canonicalSemantics.summary: Primary and secondary emphasis may coexist to distinguish two different highlighted classes in the same source.

canonicalSemantics.summary: Within foreign-language content rendered under German Braille, only Lautgruppenkürzungen may be used.

canonicalSemantics.summary: The sentence period is explicitly excluded from the general in-word cancellation-point rule.

canonicalSemantics.summary: A covered punctuation sign or arrow that occurs inside a word receives a preceding cancellation point.

primary.summary: A covered punctuation sign or arrow that occurs inside a word receives a preceding cancellation point.

canonicalSemantics.summary: The additional cancellation point applies to punctuation that is internal to lexical word material; source examples distinguish such signs from closing punctuation at the word edge.

canonicalSemantics.summary: Ordinary quotation marks inside a word are represented with the cancellation point preceding the ordinary opening or closing quotation sign.
